वै.औ.अ.प.-भारतीय समवेत औषध संस्थान (सीएसआईआर-आईआईआईएम), जम्मू, भारत सरकार के ववज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योविकी मंत्रालय के अंतिगत वैज्ञावनक एवं औद्योविक अनुसंधान ववभाि (डीएसआईआर) के 
अधीन कायगरत, वैज्ञावनक तथा औद्योविक अनुसंधान पररषद (सीएसआईआर) की एक स्वायत्त संस्था है। 
संस्थान योग्य एवं प्रेररत उम्मीदवारों से ICMR-द्वारा ववत्तपोवषत पररयोजना सं .  GAP-3183 शीषगक “Lead optimization of identified Coumarinand Indazoline anti -TB Scaffolds targeting 
Drug-Resistant and Latent Tuberculosis ” के अंतिगत वनम्नवलखित पररयोजना-आधाररत पिों के वलए आवेदन आमंवत्रत करता है, जो पूर्गतः  अस्थायी प्रक ृ दत के हैं और सीएसआईआर-
आईआईआईएम, जम्मू क े  वलए मान्य होंिे। 
CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR -IIIM), Jammu, is a premier Institute working under the aegis of Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an 
autonomous body under the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Mini stry of Science & Technology, Government of India. 
This Institute invites applications from qualified and motivated candidates for the following project -based position (s), purely on a temporary basis , under the ICMR funded 
project No. GAP-3183 titled “Lead optimization of identified Coumarinand Indazoline anti -TB Scaffolds targeting Drug -Resistant and Latent Tuberculosis ” tenable at

curtailed depending on the project duration, requirements and the performance/conduct of the incumbent(s). 
 
Page 3 of 3 
 
2) वनयुखक्त की अववध पररयोजना की अववध के साथ ही समाप्त होिी। हालााँवक, वकसी भी खस्थवत में क ु ल वनयुखक्त अववध (सभी 
सीएसआईआर प्रयोिशालाओं में की िई वनयुखक्तयों सवहत) छह वषष से अवधक नहीं होिी। कायग प्रदशगन की समय-समय पर समीक्षा की 
जाएिी और असंतोषजनक प्रदशगन की खस्थवत में वबना वकसी पूवग सूचना या कारर् बताए वनयुखक्त समाप्त की जा सकती है। 
The tenure of engagement shall be co -terminus with the project. However, under no circumstances shall the total 
tenure exceed six years, including engagement in all CSIR labs. Performance will be reviewed periodically and 
unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination without any notice or reason.  
3) यह पद पूर्गतः  अस्थायी हैं और प्रायोजक संस्था की ओर से हैं। अतः  चयवनत उम्मीदवार को सीएसआईआर-
आईआईआईएम/सीएसआईआर में वकसी भी स्थायी पद पर समायोजन या वनयुखक्त का कोई अवधकार (प्रत्यक्ष या परोक्ष) प्राप्त नहीं होिा 
The position(s) are purely temporary and are on behalf of the sponsor and, therefore, not confer any right on the 
incumbent(s) to any claim, implicit or explicit, for absorption on any post in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR. 
4) उम्मीदवारों को चयन सवमवत के समक्ष अंग्रेजी या वहंदी में संवाद करने का ववकल्प उपलब्ध होिा।  
Candidates will have the option to interact in English/Hindi before the Selection Comm ittee. 
5) आयु सीमा में छ ू ट भारत सरकार के वनयमों के अनुसार दी जाएिी। उम्मीिवार की आयु आवेिन जमा करने की अंदतम दतदि  के 
अनुसार गर्ना की जाएगी। 
Relaxation in age limit will be given as per Govt. of India Rules.  Age will be reckoned as on the  last date of 
submission of application. 
6) चयन या पैनल में शावमल वकए जाने के बाद, उम्मीदवार के मूल दस्तावेज — जैसे शैक्षवर्क योग्यता, जन्म वतवथ, जावत प्रमार् पत्र एवं आयु 
छ ू ट प्रमार् पत्र — की जांच की जाएिी। यवद वकसी भी प्रकार की ववसंिवत पाई जाती है, तो चयन/पैनल में सखम्मलन रद्द कर वदया जाएिा। 
Upon selection/empanelment, the original documents, including eligibility qualification, DOB, caste, and age 
relaxation certificate, will be verified; if any discrepancy is found, the selection/empanelment shall stand 
cancelled. 
7) साक्षात्कार के समय पररयोजना की आवश्यकता के अनुसार पदों की संख्या में पररवतगन हो सकता है। 
The number of positions may vary depending upon the project requirements at the time of Interview. 
8) वै.औ.अ.प.-भारतीय समवेत औषध संस्थान के दनिेशक को यह अवधकार सुरवक्षत है वक वे वकसी एक या सभी ववज्ञावपत पदों  को भरें 
या न भरें।  
The Director, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right to not to fill any or all advertised positions. 
9) वकसी भी प्रकार की वसफाररश या दबाव को अयोग्यता माना जाएिा, और ऐसे उम्मीदवार को पद के वलए अयोग्य घोवषत वकया जाएिा।  
Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification for the positions. 
10) जो उम्मीदवार वतगमान में सीएसआईआर-आईआईआईएम में वकसी पररयोजना पर कायगरत हैं, उन्हें वकसी नई ररखक्त के वलए आवेदन करने 
से पहले अनापवत्त प्रमार् पत्र (NOC) प्राप्त करना आवश्यक है। ऐसे उम्मीदवारों के आवेदन/उम्मीदवारी/चयन पर ववचार क े वल तभी वकया 
जाएिा जब कायागलय द्वारा एनओसी जारी वकया िया हो। 
Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR -IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) 
before applying for any new vacancy. Applications/ candidature/ selection of such candidates will only be 
considered if the NOC has been issued by the office. 
11) सभी आवेिकों को फॉमष  भरने की अंदतम दतदि तक दवज्ञापन में दनधाषररत आवश्यक योग्यता और अन्य शतों को पूरा करना 
अदनवायष है, तिा उन्हें सिाह िी जाती है  दक आवेिन करने से पहिे वे स्वयं यह सुदनदित कर िें दक वे फॉमष  भरने की अंदतम 
दतदि तक दनधाषररत न्यूनतम आवश्यक योग्यताए ं  अवश्य रखते हैं। 
All applicants must fulfi ll the essential qualification and other conditions stipulated in the advertisement 
as on the  last date of submission of application , and they are advised to satisfy themselves before 
applying that they possess at least the essential qualifications laid down as on the  last date of 
submission of application. 
12) अंतररम पूछताछों पर ववचार नहीं वकया जाएिा। 
 Interim enquiries will not be entertained. 
 
13) दकसी भी त्रुदि या असंगदत की च्छस्थदत में क ृ पया क े वि अंग्रेजी संस्करर् को अंदतम और प्रामादर्क माना जाए।  
In case of any discrepancy or error, kindly consider only the English version as final and authentic. 
 
 
वकसी भी प्रकार की पूछताछ के वलए क ृ पया वनम्न ईमेल पते पर वलिें: sumit.iiim@csir.res.in  
For any queries, please email to Dr. Sumit G Gandhi, Scientist-G and PI, at sumit.iiim@csir.res.in

सीएसआईआर-भारतीय समवेत औषध संस्ाा
CSIR-INDIAN INSTITUTE OF INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE

सूचना: सुरका सहायक के पि का अनंदिम छंटनी/सीदनंी पररणाम (दिजापन सं. 01R/2026)
Notice: Provisional Screening Result for the Post of Security Assistant (Advt. No. 01R/2026)
इस संसान ने दिजापन सं. 01R/2026 के अंिी्ि सुरका सहायक के एक (01) पि हेिु आिेिन
आमंद्ि दकए थे। उक पि के दिए पार आिेिनों की छं टनी की पदरया पूण् कर िी ीई है। अनंदिम
छं टनी/सीदनंी पररणाम सभी संबंदििों की जानकारी एिं अििोकनाथ् संिग है।
The Institute had invited applications for one (01) post of Security Assistant vide Advt.
No. 01R/2026. The scrutiny of applications received for the said post has been completed. The
provisional screening result is enclosed for the information of all concerned.
दजन अभदथ्यों को अपने आिेिन की असीकी दि के संबंि मे कोई आपद् हो अथिा जो इस संबंि मे
अभािेिन प्ुि करना चाहिे हों, िे अपना अभािेिन ई-मेि के माधम से rectt.assmt.iiim@csir.res.in
पर भेज सकिे है। ई-मेि की दिषय-पंकक “सुरका सहायक पि के अनंदिम छंटनी/सीदनंी पररणाम के
दिरु आपद्/अभािेिन” होनी चादहए। अभािेिन मे आपद् के आिार स् रप से उक्किि होने
चादहए िथा उनके समथ्न मे संबंदिि पमाण-प्/ि्ािेज संिग दकए जाने चादहए। अभािेिन दिनांक
25.10.2026 को सायं 5:00 बजे िक अदनिाय् रप से पार हो जाना चादहए।
Candidates who wish to raise any objection or submit a representation regarding the
rejection of their applications may do so by sending an e-mail to rectt.assmt.iiim@csir.res.in,
with the subject line “Representation against the Provisional Screening Result for the Post
of Security Assistant”. The grounds of objection must be clearly stated in the representation,
along with the relevant supporting certificates/documents. The representation must reach the
Institute on or before 5:00 PM on 25.10.2026.
दकसी अन माधम से अथिा दकसी अन ई-मेि आईडी पर भेजे ीए, या दनिा्ररि दिदथ के पशािा पार
पदिदनदिध दकसी भी पररकसदि मे सीकार नहीं दकए जाएँ ीे।
Representations sent through any other mode or to any other e-mail ID, or those
received after the stipulated date, shall not be entertained under any circumstances.
संिग छं टनी/सीदनंी पररणाम मे सक्दिि अभदथ्यों की उ्ीििारी पूण्ित अनंदिम है िथा जन-
दिदथ, आरकण शेणी, भूिपूि् सैदनक (ESM) की कसदि, जहाँ िाीू हो, आदि से संबंदिि मूि ि्ािेजों के
सतापन और दिजापन मे दनिा्ररि सभी पा्िा शि् की पूदि् के अिीन है। सूची मे दकसी अभथय का नाम
सक्दिि होने मा् से उसे कौशि/शारीररक िकिा एिं वककध आकिन परीका (Skill/Physical and
Personality Assessment Test) िथा पदियोीी दिकिि परीका (Competitive Written Examination) मे
सक्दिि होने का कोई अदिकार पार नहीं होीा। यदि भिय पदरया के दकसी भी चरण मे अथिा चयन के
पशाि भी यह पाया जािा है दक कोई अभथय दनिा्ररि पा्िा मानिंडों को पूरा नहीं करिा है अथिा उसने कोई
ीिि, असत या भामक जानकारी/ि्ािेज प्ुि दकए है, िो उसकी उ्ीििारी दबना दकसी अदिररक
सूचना के दनर् की जा सकिी है।
The candidature of all candidates included in the enclosed screening result is purely
provisional and subject to verification of original documents relating to date of birth,
reservation category, Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status, wherever applicable, etc., and fulfilment of
all eligibility conditions prescribed in the advertisement. Mere inclusion of a candidate's name
in the list shall not confer any right to be called for the Skill/Physical and Personality
Assessment Test and Competitive Written Examination. If, at any stage of the recruitment
process, including after selection, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil the prescribed
Page 01 of 04
 
eligibility criteria or has furnished any false, incorrect or misleading information or document,
his/her candidature shall be liable to be cancelled without any further notice.
इसके अदिररक, दजन अभदथ्यों को उनके नाम के समक उक्किि दकसी ि्ािेज को प्ुि
करने/उपिब कराने की शि् पर अनंदिम रप से सूची मे शादमि दकया ीया है, उने उक ि्ािेज
कौशि/शारीररक िकिा एिं वककध आकिन परीका के समय अथिा संसान दारा अपेदकि दकसी अन चरण
मे प्ुि करना अदनिाय् होीा। दनिा्ररि समय के भीिर अपेदकि ि्ािेज प्ुि न करने पर अभथय को भिय
पदरया मे आीे भाी िेने के दिए अपा् घोदषि दकया जा सकिा है।
Further, candidates who have been provisionally Screened-In subject to the
submission/production of any document(s), as indicated against their names, shall be required
to produce the same at the time of the Skill/Physical and Personality Assessment Test or at any
other stage, as and when required by the Institute. Failure to produce the requisite document(s)
within the stipulated time may render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the
recruitment process.
सूची िैयार करने मे यथासंभि साििानी बरिी ीई है। िथादप, सीएसआईआर-आईआईआइएम दकसी
भी चरण मे संजान मे आने िािी अनजाने मे हई ्ुदट, चाहे िह टंकण संबंिी हो अथिा अनथा, को सुिारने का
अदिकार सुरदकि रििा है।
While every care has been taken in preparing the screening result, CSIR-IIIM reserves the
right to rectify any inadvertent error, whether typographical or otherwise, detected at any
stage.

सूचन : मल्टी-ट सदक ं ग स्ट फ (एम. टी. एस.) क े  पि क  अनंदिम छ ं टनी/स्क्रीदनंग परिण म 
Notice: Provisional Screening Result for the Post of Multi-Tasking Staff(MTS) 
इस संस्थान ने विज्ञापन संख्या 05R/2025 क े  माध्यम से मल्टी-टासवक ं ग स्टाफ(एम. टी. एस.) क े  पद ं क े  विए 
आिेदन आमंवित वकए थे। इन पद ं क े  विए प्राप्त आिेदन ं की छ ं टनी प्रविया पूर्ण कर िी गई है, और अनंवतम छ ं टनी 
पररर्ाम संबंवित सभी क े  अिि कनाथण संिग्न वकए जा रहे हैं। 
This Institute had invited applications for the post s of Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS)  vide 
Advertisement No. 05R/2025. The scrutiny process of the applications received for the said post s has 
been completed, and the provisional screening result is being enclosed for information of all concerned. 
वजन अभ्यवथणय ं क  उनक े  आिेदन अस्वीक ृ त वकए जाने क े  संबंि में आपवि/प्रवतवनवित्व प्रस्तुत करना है , िे 
अपना प्रवतवनवित्व ई -मेि द्वारा rectt.assmt.iiim@csir.res.in पर विषय पंक्ति “मल्टी-ट सदक ं ग स्ट फ (एम. टी. 
एस.) पि क े  अनंदिम छ ं टनी/स्क्रीदनंग परिण म क े  दिरुद्ध आपदि/प्रदिदनदित्व” क े  साथ भेज सकते हैं। प्रवतवनवित्व 
में आपवि क े  आिार स्पष्ट रूप से अंवकत ह ं तथा संबंवित प्रमार्-पि संिग्न वकए जाए ँ । प्रवतवनवित्व वदनांक 30.09.2026 
तक अिश्य प्राप्त ह  जाना चावहए। 
Candidates who wish to s ubmit any objection /representation regarding the rejection of their 
applications may send their representation through e -mail at rectt.assmt.iiim@csir.res.in with the 
subject line “Representation against the Provisional Screening Result for the Post of Multi-Tasking 
Staff(MTS)”. The grounds of objection must be clearly mentioned in the representation and relevant 
supporting certificates /documents should be enclosed . The representation must reach on or before  
30.09.2026.  
वकसी अन्य माध्यम से अथिा वक सी अन्य ई -मेि आईडी पर भेजे गए  या वनिाणररत वतवथ क े  पश्चात् प्राप्त 
प्रवतवनवित्व वकसी भी पररक्तस्थवत में स्वीकार नहीं वकए जाए ँ गे। 
Representations sent through any other mode or to any other e -mail ID or those received after 
the stipulated date, shall not be entertained under any circumstances. 
    संिग्न स्क्रीवनंग पररर्ाम में सक्तिवित अभ्यवथणय ं की उिीदिारी  पूर्णतः  अनंवतम है तथा यह आयु , शैक्षवर्क य ग्यता, 
श्रेर्ी एिं विज्ञापन में वनिाणररत अन्य सभी पािता शतों से संबंवित मूि अवभिेख ं क े  सत्यापन क े  अिीन रहेगी। सूची में नाम शावमि 
ह ने माि से वकसी अभ्यथी क  ट रैड टेस्ट/प्रवतस्पिाणत्मक विक्तखत परीक्षा हेतु बुिाए जाने का क ई  अविकार प्राप्त नहीं ह गा। यवद 
भती प्रविया क े  वकसी भी चरर् में अथिा चयन क े  बाद यह पाया जाता है वक क ई अभ्यथी वनिाणररत पािता शतों क  पूरा नहीं 
कताण है अथिा क ई वमथ्या , गित अथिा भ्रामक सूचना /दस्तािेज प्रस्तुत वकया गया है , त  उसकी उिीदिारी वबना क ई कारर् 
बताए अथिा पूिण सूचना वदए वनरस्त की जा सकती है। 
          The candidature of the candidates included in the enclosed Screening Result is purely provisional 
and subject to verification of the original documents pertaining to age, educational qualifications, category and 
fulfilment of all eligibility conditions prescribed in the advertisement. Mere inclusion of a candidate’s name in 
the list does not confer any right to be called for the Trade Test/Competitive Written Examination. If, at any 
stage of the recruitment process, or even after selection, it is found that a candidate does not satisfy the 
prescribed eligibility criteria or has furnished any false, incorrect or misleading information/document, his/her 
candidature shall be liable to be cancelled without assigning any reason or further notice. 
 
इसक े  अिािा, िे अभ्यथी वजन्हें उनक े  नाम क े  सामने दशाणए गए वकसी दस्तािेज/दस्तािेज ं क  जमा/प्रस्तुत करने 
की शतण क े  अिीन अनंवतम रूप से स्क्रीन-इन वकया गया है, उन्हें उि दस्तािेज/दस्तािेज ं क  ट रेड टेस्ट क े  समय अथिा 
संस्थान द्वारा जब भी और वजस भी स्तर पर अपेवक्षत वकया जाए, जमा करना अवनिायण ह गा। वनिाणररत समयािवि क े  भीतर 
अपेवक्षत दस्तािेज/दस्तािेज ं क  प्रस्तुत करने में विफि रहने पर अभ्यथी क  भती प्रविया में आगे भाग िेने क े  विए अपाि 
माना जाएगा। 
Furthermore, candidates who have been provisionally Screened -In subject to 
submission/production of any document(s), as indicated against their names, shall be required to 
 
 
      
 
produce the same at the time of the Trade Test or at any oth er stage, as and when required by the 
Institute. Failure to produce the requisite document(s) within the stipulated time may render the 
candidate ineligible for further participation in the recruitment process. 
 
सूवचय ं क  तैयार करने में यथासंभि पूर्ण साििानी बरती गई है। तथावप , सीएसआईआर-आईआईआइएम क  वकसी 
भी स्तर पर पाई जाने िािी अनजाने में हुई िुवट, चाहे िह टंकर् संबंिी ह  अथिा अन्यथा, क  सुिारने का अविकार सुरवक्षत है। 
           While every care has been taken in preparing the lists, CSIR -IIIM reserves the right to rectify any 
inadvertent error, typographical or otherwise, detected at any stage.

दिजाञन संखा 04R/2025 के अंतर्त दिजादञत कदनष आशुदिदञक ञि हेतु संसान क् िेबसाइट ञि
समसंखक िेब सूचना दिनांक 17.06.2026 के माधम से पकादशत अनंदतम स्दनंर ञरिणाम, दिसके दिरु दिनांक
30.06.2026 तक अभािेिन आमंद्त दकए रए थे, के संिर् मे दनरा्रित अिदर के र्ति पार अभािेिनदं ञि दिदरित
रदित स्दनंर सदमदत दािा दिचाि दकया रया। सदमदत क् अनुशंसाओं के आराि ञि सदमदत के दनण्यदं कद सम्दित
किते हए स्दनंर ञरिणाम अनुिगक-क के रञ मे संिग है।
With reference to the Provisional Screening Result for the post of Junior Stenographer
advertised vide Advt. No. 04R/2025, published on the Institute's website vide Web Notice of even
number dated 17.06.2026, whereby representations were invited up to 30.06.2026, the representations
received within the stipulated period were considered by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
Based on the recommendations of the Committee, the Screening Result, incorporating the decisions of
the Committee, is enclosed as Annexure-I.
संिग स्दनंर ञरिणाम मे सम्दित अभदथ्यदं क् उ््ििाि् ञूण्तत अनंदतम है तथा यह आयु, शैकदणक
यदगता, शेण् एिं दिजाञन मे दनरा्रित अन सर् ञा्ता शत् से संबंदरत मूि अदरिेखदं के सताञन के अर्न िहेर्।
सूच् मे नाम शादमि हदने मा् से दकस् अभथय कद आशुदिदञ िकता ञि्कण/पदततरा्पक दिमखत ञि्का हेतु
बुिाए िाने का कदई अदरकाि पार नह्ं हदरा। यदि रतय पदरया के दकस् र् चिण मे अथिा चयन के बाि यह ञाया
िाता है दक कदई अभथय दनरा्रित ञा्ता शत् कद ञूिा नह्ं कता् है अथिा कदई दमथा, रित अथिा भामक
सूचना/िसािेि पसुत दकया रया है, तद उसक् उ््ििाि् दबना कदई कािण बताए अथिा ञूि् सूचना दिए दनिस क्
िा सकत् है।

🅽🅴🆆👉 Cancellation of Recruitment Process for Certain Posts Advertised vide Advt. No. 02R/2024 and Notification of Revised Final Consolidated List for the Posts of Technical Officer, Technical Assistant and Technician(1). View Notice
 
सीएसआईआर-भारतीय समवेत औषध संसाथ
CSIR-INDIAN INSTITUTE OF INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE
थहर मार्, जम्, जम् एवं कशीर - 180001
CANAL ROAD, JAMMU, JAMMU & KASHMIR - 180001
सं./No.: A-12024/1/2023-R&A-IIIM दिथांक/Dated: 08.07.2026
स्चथा/Notice
दवषय: दवजाञथ सं. 02R/2024 के माधम से दवजादञत कु छ ञिों हेतु भत् पदरया का दथरसीकरक
तथा तकथीकी अदधकारी, तकथीकी सहायक एवं तकथीदियथ(1) के ञिों हेतु संिोदधत
अंदतम समेदकत स्ची की अदधस्चथा
Sub.: Cancellation of Recruitment Process for Certain Posts Advertised vide Advt. No.
02R/2024 and Notification of Revised Final Consolidated List for the Posts of
Technical Officer, Technical Assistant and Technician(1)
दवजाञथ संखा 02R/2024 के अंतर्त तकथीकी सहायक एवं तकथीदियथ (1) के दवदभन ञिों ञर भत् के संिभ्
मे यह अदधस्दचत दकया जाता है दक दथमदनलित ञोस कोडों के अंतर्त दवजादञत ञि अञया्ा पदतदरया सदहत
पिासदथक कारकों से चन रही भत् पदरया से दथरस दकए जाते है:
With reference to Advt. No. 02R/2024 for recruitment to various posts of Technical Assistant and
Technician (1), it is hereby notified that the following posts, under the post codes indicated below, stand
cancelled from the ongoing recruitment process due to administrative reasons including insufficient
response:
Sl. No. Post Code Category of Post
Advertised Trade/Area No. of Posts
1. T-09 EWS Computer Engineering 01
2. T-17 UR-PwBD (HH) Library Sciences 01
3. T-19 EWS Instrument Mechanic 01
4. T-20 OBC Horticulture 01*
5. T-20 EWS Horticulture 01
6. T-21A UR-ESM IT & System Maintenance 01
7. T-23A UR-ESM Electrician 01
8. T-28 EWS Lab Assistant 01
9. T-29 OBC Pump Operator 01
10. TBL-01 OBC PwBD (HH) Computer Operator &
Programming Assistant 01
11. TBL-02A OBC Horticulture 01
12. TBL-05 ST Nursing Assistant 01
* ओबीसी शेकी के अंतर्त ञोस कोड T-20 के अंतर्त दवजादञत िो ञिों मे से एक ञि दथरस दकया जाता है।
* Out of the two posts advertised under Post Code T-20 in the OBC category, one post stands cancelled.
यह भी स् दकया जाता है दक रम संखा 1 ञर उल्लित ञि को दवजाञथ संखा 15/2021 से ञुथः दवजादञत
दकया रया था, जबदक रम संखा 3 से 12 तक के ञिों को दवजाञथ संखा 01R/2023 से ञुथः दवजादञत दकया रया था।
तिथुसार, दवजाञथ संखा 15/2021 एवं 01R/2023 के अंतर्त संबंदधत ञि भी वाञस दनए जाते है।
It is further clarified that the post at Sl. No. 1 above was re-advertised from Advt. No. 15/2021,
while the posts under Sl. Nos. 3 to 12 were re-advertised from Advt. No. 01R/2023. Accordingly, the
corresponding posts under Advt. Nos. 15/2021 and 01R/2023 also stand withdrawn.
तिथुसार, उञयु्ु ञिों के संबंध मे वत्माथ भत् अदभयाथ के अंतर्त ट्ड टेस/दनलित ञरीका सदहत कोई भी
आरे की भत् पदरया आयोदजत थहीं की जाएरी। इथ ञिों के दवरु ररलुयों को नार् दथयमों एवं आवशकताओं के
अथुसार भदवष की भत् पदरयाओं मे भरे जाथे हेतु दवचार दकया जा सकता है।
Accordingly, no further recruitment process, including trade test/written examination, shall be
undertaken for the aforesaid posts under the current recruitment drive. The vacancies against these
posts may be considered for filling up in future recruitment drives, as per the applicable rules and
requirements.
जारी/Cont…2/-
 
- 2 -
इसके अदतररु, दवजाञथ संखा 02R/2024 के सीदथंर ञररकाम, जो समसंखक वेब स्चथा दिथांक
18.12.2025 के माधम से पकादित दकया रया था तथा समसंखक वेब स्चथा दिथांक 15.01.2026 के माधम से
पकादित सीथड-इथ अभदथ्यों की समेदकत स्ची मे आंदिक संिोधथ करते हए, ञि कोड T-11 के अंतर्त आवेिथ
संखा T11-0025 धारक अभथ् को, ञि हेतु ञात ञाए जाथे के फनस्ञ, सीथड-इथ अभदथ्यों की स्ची मे सलमदनत
दकया जाता है। इसके अदतररु, ञि कोड T-20 के अंतर्त आवेिथ संखा T20-0012 धारक अभथ् की अभदथ्ता
असीकार दकए जाथे का कारक संिोदधत कर “संबंदधत केत मे अथुभव दथधा्ररत अवदध से कम” दकया जाता है।
Further, in partial modification of the Screening Result of Advt. No. 02R/2024 published vide
Web Notice of even number dated 18.12.2025 and the Consolidated List of Screened-In Candidates
published vide Web Notice of even number dated 15.01.2026, the candidate bearing Application No. T11-
0025 under Post Code T-11, being eligible for the post, is hereby included in the list of Screened-In
candidates. Additionally, the reason for rejection of candidature of the candidate bearing Application No.
T20-0012 under Post Code T-20 stands revised as “Experience in the relevant field less than the
prescribed duration.”
तिथुसार, उञयु्ु संिोधथों को सलमदनत करते हए संिोदधत अंदतम समेदकत स्ची सभी संबंदधतों की जाथकारी
हेतु इसके साथ संनग की जाती है।
Accordingly, the revised Final Consolidated List, incorporating the aforesaid modifications, is
annexed hereto for the information of all concerned.
स्ची मे सलमदनत सभी अभदथ्यों की अभदथ्ता ञ्क्तः असायी है। स्ची मे थाम िादमन होथे मात से दकसी
अभथ् को ट्ेड टेस/दनलित ञरीका हेतु बुनाए जाथे का कोई अदधकार पाा थहीं होरा। यदि भत् पदरया के दकसी भी
चरक मे अथवा चयथ के ञशात यह ञाया जाता है दक अभथ् दवजाञथों एवं/अथवा दकसी ञशातवत् अदधस्चथा/िुलुञत मे
दथदि्् ञातता ित् या अन दथयमों एवं ित् को ञ्रा थहीं करता है, तो उसकी अभदथ्ता दबथा दकसी ञ्व् स्चथा के
दथरस/असीकी त कर िी जाएरी तथा इस संबंध मे दकसी भी अञीन ञर दवचार थहीं दकया जाएरा।
The candidature of all shortlisted candidates is purely provisional. Mere inclusion of a candidate’s
name in the list does not confer any right to be called for the Trade Test/Written Examination. If at any
stage of the recruitment process, or even after selection, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of
the eligibility conditions or other terms and conditions stipulated in the aforesaid advertisements and/or
any subsequent notification/corrigendum, his/her candidature shall be summarily cancelled/rejected
without any further notice, and no appeal against such cancellation/rejection shall be entertained.
दजथ अभदथ्यों को उथके थाम के समक उल्लित दवदि्/आवशक िसावेजों के पसुदतकरक की ित् ञर
िॉट्दनस दकया रया है, उने उु िसावेज ट्ेड टेस के समय अदथवाय् ्ञ से पसुत करथे होंरे।
Candidates shortlisted subject to submission of specific/requisite documents, as indicated
against their respective names, must mandatorily produce the same at the time of the Trade Test.
यददञ स्ची तैयार करथे मे ञ्क् सावधाथी बरती रई है, तथादञ सीएसआईआर-आईआईआईएम भत् पदरया के
दकसी भी चरक मे दकसी भी अथजाथे तुदट अथवा टंकक तुदट को संिोदधत करथे का अदधकार सुरदकत रिता है।
While every care has been taken in preparing the list, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right to rectify any
inadvertent error or typographical mistake at any stage of the recruitment process.
भत् पदरया के आरामी चरकों के संबंध मे स्चथा संसाथ की वेबसाइट ञर समयाथुसार अदधस्दचत की जाएरी।
सभी संबंदधत अभदथ्यों को सनाह िी जाती है दक वे थवीथतम जाथकारी हेतु संसाथ की वेबसाइट (https://iiim.res.in/)
दथयदमत ्ञ से िेिते रहे।
Further information regarding the next stage(s) of recruitment shall be notified on the Institute’s
website in due course. All concerned applicants are advised to visit the Institute’s website
(https://iiim.res.in/) regularly for updates.
हसा/-

🅽🅴🆆👉 Consolidation of Vacancies Advertised under Advt. Nos. 15/2021, 01R/2023 and 02R/2024 – Revised List. View Notice
 
सीएसआईआर-भारतीय समवेत औषध संस्ाा
CSIR-INDIAN INSTITUTE OF INTEGRATIVE MEDICINE
नहर मार्, जममम, जममम एवं कशममर - 180001
CANAL ROAD, JAMMU, JAMMU & KASHMIR - 180001
सं./No.: A-12024/1/2023-R&A-IIIM दिाांक/Dated: 15.01.2026
NOTICE
विषय: विज्ञा सं. 15/2021, 01R/2023 एिं 02R/2024 के अंतर्त विज्वञत रिक्यिं क् समेका –
संशिवित सूची।
Sub.: Consolidation of Vacancies Advertised under Advt. Nos. 15/2021, 01R/2023 and
02R/2024 - Revised List.
विा्ंक 15.01.2026 के समसंखक िेब-ािविस, विसके म्धम से विज्ञा सं. 15/2021, 01R/2023
एिं 02R/2024 के अंतर्त ञुाः विज्वञत ञििं की समेवकत सीवांर सूची तथ् ािीा ञििं की सीवांर सूची
अविसूवचत की रई थी, मे आंवशक संशििा किते हए यह अिलिवकत हआ है वक कु छ ा्म अाि्ाे मे छू ि रए
थे। अतः संशिवित सूची एतद् ि्ि् अविसूवचत की ि्ती है।
In partial modification of the Web-Notice of even number dated 15.01.2026, whereby the
consolidated screened-in list of re-advertised posts as well as the screened-in list of fresh posts
under Advt. Nos. 15/2021, 01R/2023 and 02R/2024 were notified, it has been observed that
some names were inadvertently omitted. Accordingly, the revised list is hereby notified.
सूची मे सक्वलत सभी अभवथ्यिं की अभवथ्त् ञूर्तः अस्यी है। सूची मे ा्म श्वमल हिाे म्त से
वकसी अभथय कि ि्ेे िेस/वलकित ञिीक् हेतु बुल्ए ि्ाे क् किई अविक्ि प्र ाहीं हिर्। यवि भतय
पवरय् के वकसी भी चिर मे अथि् चया के ञश्त यह ञ्य् ि्त् है वक अभथय विज्ञािं एिं/अथि् वकसी
ञश्तितय अविसूचा्/शुक्ञत मे वावि्ि ञ्तत् शत् य् अन वायमिं एिं शत् कि ञूि् ाहीं कित् है, ति उसकी
अभवथ्त् वबा् वकसी ञूि् सूचा् के वािस/असीकी त कि िी ि्एरी तथ् इस संबंि मे वकसी भी अञील ञि
विच्ि ाहीं वकय् ि्एर्।
The candidature of all shortlisted candidates is purely provisional. Mere inclusion of a
candidate’s name in the list does not confer any right to be called for the Trade Test/Written
Examination. If at any stage of the recruitment process, or even after selection, it is found that a
candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility conditions or other terms and conditions
stipulated in the aforesaid advertisements and/or any subsequent notification/corrigendum,
his/her candidature shall be summarily cancelled/rejected without any further notice, and no
appeal against such cancellation/rejection shall be entertained.
विा अभवथ्यिं कि उाके ा्म के समक उक्कित विवशि/आिशक िस्िेििं के पसुवतकिर की
शत् ञि शॉि्वलस वकय् रय् है, उने उ् िस्िेि ि्ेे िेस के समय अवाि्य् रञ से पसुत किाे हिंरे।
Candidates shortlisted subject to submission of specific/requisite documents, as
indicated against their respective names, must mandatorily produce the same at the time of the
Trade Test.
यदवञ सूची तैय्ि किाे मे ञूर् स्िि्ाी बिती रई है, तथ्वञ सीएसआईआि-आईआईआईएम भतय
पवरय् के वकसी भी चिर मे वकसी भी अाि्ाे तुवि अथि् िंकर तुवि कि संशिवित किाे क् अविक्ि
सुिवकत िित् है।
While every care has been taken in preparing the list, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right to
rectify any inadvertent error or typographical mistake at any stage of the recruitment process.
भतय पवरय् के आर्मी चिरिं के संबंि मे सूचा् संस्ा की िेबस्इि ञि समय्ाुस्ि अविसूवचत की
ि्िी...

 
ि्एरी। सभी संबंवित अभवथ्यिं कि सल्ह िी ि्ती है वक िे ािीातम ि्ाक्िी हेतु संस्ा की िेबस्इि
(https://iiim.res.in/) वायवमत रञ से िेिते िहे।
Further information regarding the next stage(s) of recruitment shall be notified on the
Institute’s website in due course. All concerned applicants are advised to visit the Institute’s
website (https://iiim.res.in/) regularly for updates.
हस्/-
(ि्िेश रुर्/Rajesh Gupta)

The CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun is a premier Institute under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), dedicated in multidisciplinary R&D programmes of both basic and applied nature across scientific disciplines for economic, environmental and societal benefits for the people of India. CSIR-IIP has a rich legacy of being a pioneer in the area of Petroleum & Hydrocarbon industry and is presently engaged in the development of sophisticated green technologies to cater to the energy needs of modern world and for reducing carbon footprint. CSIR-IIP has developed and transferred technologies to industries in the areas of petroleum refining, natural gas, petrochemicals, chemicals and utilisation of petroleum products, provided technical services and imparted world class training to the human resource of Oil and Refining industry. CSIR-IIP has strong collaborations with industries and academia in India & abroad and has outstanding scientists in the multidisciplinary areas of R&D in the hydrocarbon and related industry.   Applications are invited from enthusiastic Indian Nationals having excellent academic record and proven technical skills along with the requisite experience and a high degree of motivation for the jobs assigned, to fill up the vacancies of following posts as per the details given below:  Sl. (C) Benefits under Council Service 
 
1) These posts carry usual allowances i.e. Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), 
Transport Allowance (TA) etc. as admissible to the central government employees and as made 
applicable to CSIR. Council employees are also eligible for accommodation of their entitled type as per 
the CSIR Resident allotment rules depending on availability in which case, HRA will not be admissible.  
2) In addition to the emoluments indicated against each category of posts, benefits such as 
reimbursements of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession, Children’s Education Allowance, 
Conveyance advance and House Building Advance are available as per CSIR rules. 
3) The Selected candidates will be governed by the ‘National Pension Scheme’ or Extant Pension System 
based on defined contribution as adopted by CSIR for its employees. 
4) CSIR provides excellent opportunities to deserving candidates for career advancement under 
Assessment Promotion scheme for Technical (Gr. III) and Support Staff (Gr. II), as per rules as 
amended from time to time. 
5) In regard to all the matters concerning service conditions of employees of the Society, Central Civil 
Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 
1965, the Fundamental and Supplementary Rules framed by the Govt. of India and such other rules 
and orders issued by the Govt. of India from time to time shall apply to the extent applicable to the 
employees of the Council. 
6) All the posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) i.e. the candidate on selection may be asked to 
serve anywhere in the country. 
 
(D) General Conditions 
 
1) The applicant must be citizen of India. 
2) All applicants must fulfill essential requirements of the post and other conditions stipulated in the 
advertisement as on the last date of receipt of online application. They are advised to satisfy 
themselves before applying, that they possess at least the essential qualification laid down for these 
posts which is compulsory even if a candidate has some higher qualifications. No enquiry asking for 
advice as to eligibility will be entertained. 
3) The period of experience in a discipline/area of work, where prescribed, shall be counted after the 
date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualification for that Post. 
4) The online application should be accompanied by scanned copies of the essential educational 
qualification, experience, date of birth proof etc. The prescribed qualifications should have been 
obtained through recognized Universities/Institutions etc. Incomplete applications or not accompanied 
with the essential certificates/documents, are liable to be rejected. 
5) In respect of equivalent clause in Essential Qualifications, if a candidate is claiming a particular 
qualification as equivalent qualification as per the requirement of advertisement, then the candidate is 
required to produce order/letter in this regard, indicating the Authority (with number and date) under 
which it has been so treated otherwise the Application is liable to be rejected. 
6) If any document/certificate furnished is in a language other than Hindi or English, a transcript of the 
same duly attested by a gazetted officer or Notary is to be submitted.  
7) In case of Universities/Institutes/Boards awarding Grades etc., candidates are required to convert the 
same into percentage based on the formula given by their University/Institute/Board, which is to be 
supported also by relevant documents. In the absence of any formula being available, it may be 
considered either as linear scale (Example: Grade of 8.65 = 86.5% and vice versa) or any other 
formula may be considered by CSIR-IIP to arrive at the percentage of marks. Institute's decision in this 
regard will be final and binding on the applicants. 
8) The date for determining the upper age limit, qualifications and/or experience shall be the closing date 
prescribed for submission of online applications i.e. 18.08.2025. 
9) Any discrepancy found between the information given in application and as evident in original 
documents will make the candidate ineligible for appearing in Trade Test/ Skill Test and/or Written 
Test. 
10) Mere fulfilling of minimum prescribed qualification and experience will not vest any right in a candidate 
for being called for Trade/Skill Test.  If large number of applications received, the Screening 
Committee may adopt its own criteria for shortlisting the candidates to be called for Trade/Skill Test. 
The Institute reserves the rights to call for Trade/Skill Test only those candidates who in its opinion are 
likely to be suitable and will not entertain any correspondence in this regard. The candidates should, 
therefore, mention all the qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the 
minimum prescribed qualifications.  
 
Page 6 of 8 
 
11) Women candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria prescribed under GOI instructions are encouraged to 
apply.  
12) Applications from employees working in CSIR, Government Departments, Public Sector Organizations, 
Autonomous Institutions will be considered only if their applications are forwarded through proper 
channel and received within 15 days from the closing date prescribed for receipt of hardcopy of 
application, and with a clear certificate that the applicant will be relieved within one month of the receipt 
of appointment order, if selected. However, candidates can send an advance copy along with 
necessary application fee (wherever applicable) before the last date of receipt of completed application 
form. 
13) For work experience, wherever required, the candidates are required to submit experience certificate in 
proper format. Salary Slip or Joining Letter/OM shall not be considered as valid proof of experience. 
14) Application Fee: Candidates belonging to General, OBC & EWS category are required to arrange to 
deposit fee of Rs. 500/- through SB Collect.  SC/ST/PWD/Women/Ex-servicemen and candidates 
residing abroad are exempted from payment of application fee. 
15) Candidates applying for more than one post should apply separately for each post indicating the Post 
Code of the post accompanied by separate requisite fee of Rs. 500/- through SB Collect. 
16) Applications once submitted will not be allowed to be withdrawn. Application fee once paid will neither 
be refunded on any count nor will be held in reserve for any other recruitment or selection process.  
17) Incomplete applications i.e. without passport size photograph affixed on the application, without self-
attested certificates, without manual signature on application printout, without requisite application fee, 
wherever applicable, without relevant testimonials in support of Date of Birth, Qualification, Experience, 
Caste, EWS certificate etc. will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected.  
18) No Travelling Allowance will be reimbursed for appearing in Trade/Skill Test/Written Examination. 
19) The appointment will be in CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun, Uttarakhand under the 
Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) which is an Autonomous Body under the 
administrative control of DSIR, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. The appointees are 
liable to be transferred/posted in any of the Laboratories/Institutes of CSIR situated anywhere in India, 
as and when required or any extension center/unit of CSIR-IIP anywhere in India.  
20) The decision of the Director, CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun (CSIR-IIP) in all matters 
relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and conduct of Trade Test/Skill Test will be 
final and binding on the candidates and no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained in this 
connection from any individual or his/her agency.  
21) Notification regarding details of shortlisted candidates to be called for Trade/Skill Test along with the 
criterion adopted by the Screening Committee and any updates shall be displayed only on the 
Institute’s website i.e. https://www.iip.res.in from time to time. 
22) All future corrigendum/addendum/notifications etc. and announcements/details pertaining to this 
recruitment process shall be published/provided ONLY on https://www.iip.res.in from time to time. 
23) The selection procedure of these posts is subject to the CSIR/Govt. of India instructions prevalent at 
the time of various stages of the selection. 
24) The Director, CSIR-IIP, Dehradun reserves the right to amend, delete and add terms & conditions to 
this advertisement. 
25) The Director, CSIR-IIP reserves the right to cancel the advertisement without assigning any reason 
thereof or reserves the right to not fill up any or some of the posts. 
 
(E) Age Relaxations 
 
1) Age and experience will be reckoned as on the last date of the receipt of online application i.e. 
18.08.2025. 
2) The upper age limit is relaxable up to 05 [five] years for Scheduled Caste [SC]/Scheduled Tribe [ST] 
and 03 [three] years for Other Backward Class [OBC] candidates, as per Government of India orders in 
force, only where the posts are reserved for these respective categories [attested copies of the 
certificates to be enclosed to the application, as required]. SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against 
the posts not reserved for them are not eligible for age relaxation in respect of such posts and they are 
treated at par with the general candidates in respect of their selection. Application Fee Exemption is, 
however, applicable for SC and ST candidates in such cases. 
3) Upper age limit is also relaxable up to five years for the regular employees working in CSIR 
Laboratories/Institutes, Government Dept., Autonomous Bodies and Public Sector Undertakings in 
 
Page 7 of 8 
 
accordance with the instructions and orders issued by the Government of India/CSIR from time to time 
in this regard, subject to the condition that their applications are forwarded through proper channel. 
4) Upper age limit for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWDs) will be relaxable by 10 years (15 
years for SC/ST & 13 years for OBC for posts reserved for SC/ST and OBC). The persons claiming 
age relaxation under PWD category would be required to produce a certificate in the prescribed 
proforma issued by the Competent Authority (as the case may be) specified in Rights of Persons with 
disabilities Rules, 2017 issued by Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities 
(Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India vide Notification No. G.S.R 
591(E) dated 15.06.2017, as amended from time to time in support of their claims clearly indicating 
that the degree of physical disability is 40% or more. In any case, the appointment of these candidates 
will be subject to their being found medically fit in accordance with the standards of medical fitness as 
prescribed by the Government. 
5) As per GOI provisions, age relaxation for widows, divorced women and women judicially separated 
from their husbands who are not remarried, the upper age limit is relaxable up to the age of 35 years 
(upto 40 years for members of Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes and upto 38 years for members 
belonging to the Other Backward Classes (non creamy layer) in respect of the posts reserved for 
them). The persons claiming age relaxation would be required to produce following documentary 
evidence:  
a)  In case of widow, death certificate of her husband together with the Affidavit that she has not remarried 
since.  
b)  In case of divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands, a certified copy of the 
judgment/decree of the appropriate Court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case 
may be, with an Affidavit in respect of divorced women that they have not remarried since.  
 
6) Upper age limit is relaxable by 03 years, after deduction of the rendered military service from the   
actual age for Ex-servicemen, as on the closing date for submission of online application. Only those 
candidates shall be treated as Ex-Servicemen who fulfill the definition and criteria as laid down in 
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India Gazette Notification No. 
G.S.R 757 (E) dated 04.10.2012 and DoPT instructions issued vide OM No. No. 36034/3/2013-Estt 
(Res) dated 25th February, 2014, as amended from time to time.   
 
(F) How to Apply: 
 
(1) Eligible candidates are required to submit ONLINE application through the Institute website 
https://www.iip.res.in. 
(2) If the candidate does not have a valid E-mail ID, he/she should create a new valid E-mail ID before 
applying online. 
(3) The candidates have to attach only one PDF file containing scanned copies of original educational 
qualification certificates, professional qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, 
Caste certificate (if applicable), fee receipt and other documents with the online application form. 
(4) The computer generated Application Form (print-out) duly manually signed accompanied by self 
attested copies of the certificates, mark sheets, testimonials in support of age, education 
qualifications, experience and caste certificate, if applicable along with one recent passport size self-
signed photograph affixed together with the receipt of application fee(if applicable) should be sent in 
an envelope superscribed “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____________ (Post Code 
________)” only by Registered/Speed Post to the address: Sr. Controller of Administration, CSIR-
Indian Institute of Petroleum, P.O. I.I.P., Mohkampur, Haridwar Road, Dehradun-248005 
(Uttarakhand).  The last date for receipt of hard copy of application is 26.08.2025 (5:30 PM), this 
date will be same for the candidates belonging to far-flung areas also. 
(5) It should be kept in mind that in the hard copy of the Application Form, the candidate is required to 
affix his recent color photograph on front page of the application proforma duly signed across and 
also manually sign on the last page of application proforma. Unsigned application and without affixing 
photography will not be considered and are liable to be rejected. 
(6) If a candidate fails to submit the hard copy, which should reach by 26.08.2025 then his/her 
candidature will be rejected. For postal delay, office will not be responsible. 
(7) For any technical query while applying online, please send e-mail to recruitment@iip.res.in. The 
query received after 5:00 PM on 18.08.2025, shall not be entertained.  
(8) Applications from employees of Government Departments, Autonomous bodies and Public Sector 
Undertakings will be considered only, if forwarded through proper channel, certified by their office that 
the applicant, if selected, will be relieved within one month of the receipt of the appointment orders. 
Also, vigilance clearance should also be recorded. However, advance copy of the application may be
